checks.description: LaTeX compiles to PDF without fatal errors
Uses the bundled IEEEtran class in conference mode
Within the page limit (6 pages, up to 8 with overlength pages)
US Letter paper (8.5 x 11 in)
All fonts embedded in the PDF (IEEE PDF eXpress requirement)
No packages that change IEEE margins, spacing or headings
Has Introduction and Conclusion sections
Abstract present and at most 250 words
Index Terms (keywords) present
Every referenced figure file is present and embeddable
Every \cite key has a bibliography entry
No undefined \ref labels
Paper has a reference list
No text sticking into the margin (overfull boxes larger than 5pt)
Every character prints (no glyphs missing from the font)
No heading has a single subheading
Citation numbers are not used as words
References give conference places, journal months and the author names

params.example: in Proc. Abbrev. Name of Conf., City, Country, Year, pp. x–y
params.authors_rule: IEEE lists every author unless there are more than six

checks.description: Abstract of 150 to 250 words
Abstract is one paragraph without math, citations or footnotes
Title in title case, without math, "new" or "novel"
Headings in title case
Affiliations give a city and country
American spelling throughout
No eqnarray environment

params.message: IEEE asks for align (or IEEEeqnarray) instead of eqnarray, which spaces the equals signs badly.

checks.description: A space between each number and its unit

params.message: Put a space between a number and its unit, as in "10 ms" (IEEE style).

checks.description: Abbreviations are spelled out at first use
No plain underscores in the text
Images print at 300 dpi or more
Review version gives no hint of the authors (self-citations, links, emails, grants)
Add the IEEE copyright notice required by your conference after acceptance
Validate the final PDF with IEEE PDF eXpress if your conference requires it
Check figures are legible in print and in grayscale
Confirm the page limit and anonymity policy in your conference's call for papers
If AI tools wrote any content, name them and the sections in the Acknowledgment (editing and grammar help need no disclosure)
No leftover notes to self (\todo, TODO, FIXME)

params.message: The paper still has notes to self. Remove them, or write the missing text, before you submit.

checks.description: Citations are numbered, not typed as (Author, Year)

params.message: IEEE numbers its citations [1]; these look like author-year citations typed as text. Cite them with \cite and a .bib file, or a numbered reference list.

checks.description: Typed figure and table numbers match the paper, and every figure and table has a caption

manual_review_items: Author names, affiliations and emails were copied from your upload; confirm them.
Equation, table and figure placement may differ from your original layout.
